stem: Kavya needs a lunch-box lid that will not leak watery dal. She compares a tight plastic lid with an open woven cloth cover.

parts.text: Which material better fits the purpose of this lid?

options.text: Tight plastic lid that keeps watery dal from leaking.
Open woven cloth, because it feels soft in the hand.
Either plastic or cloth, because any cover fits any lunch box.
Open woven cloth, because a lid must let air through freely.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The lid must stop watery dal from leaking, so a tight plastic lid matches that purpose better than an open woven cloth.

teacher.key_rationale: A material is chosen when its properties fit the object's purpose. A lunch-box lid that must not leak needs a tight seal; soft feel or free airflow alone do not meet that purpose.
